what: PostToolUse hook is registered only for matcher Read
scenario_or_breakage: #3175 polled via Bash cat of tasks/*.output; extending hook-anti-read-poll.sh alone never receives Bash PostToolUse events, so the primary mechanical fix is inert in production while the offline harness still passes
suggested_fix: Register the same script for Bash (e.g. matcher Read|Bash or a second PostToolUse entry) and update hook-anti-read-poll.md to document the matcher; add a harness note that direct invocation does not substitute for hooks.json wiring
